description: Defines the H3App class for managing HTTP/3 server operations, including context creation, route handling, and server control within the uWS namespace.

classes.name: H3App
classes.description: A class encapsulating an HTTP/3 server application, providing methods for server setup, route handling, and execution.

methods.name: H3App
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HTTP/3 context with provided socket options.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Overloaded methods to start listening on specified host and port with optional parameters and handlers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Registers a GET route with a handler.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Registers a POST route with a handler.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Registers an OPTIONS route with a handler.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Registers a DELETE route with a handler.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Registers a PATCH route with a handler.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Registers a PUT route with a handler.

methods.name: head
methods.description: Registers a HEAD route with a handler.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Registers a CONNECT route with a handler.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Registers a TRACE route with a handler.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Registers a route that matches any HTTP method with a handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the event loop to run the server.
